title: Palisades (Holtec restart): External_Sender Re: Holtec Palisades Request for Deviation of Nuclear Safety Rules [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:           C & A Bowman
To:             Marlayna Doell
Subject:        [External_Sender] Re: Holtec Palisades Request for deviation of nuclear safety rulles
Date:           Thursday, October 8, 2026 1:34:21 PM


Hello,
I object to approving Holtec's request to bend the ALARA rules and remove the tilted fuel
assembly bundle (DD41) using never-before-tested methods. It's my understanding that this
refueling accident has never been experienced before in the history of nuclear power. There has
been no time for outside nuclear experts to weigh in on this untested method of fuel bundle
removal. As such, please do not approve Holtec's request until outside nuclear experts have
assessed this situation, and until the public allowed sufficient time to comment.

Thank you.
Charles Bowman
48 Sandelwood Dr
Getzville NY 14068
tel: 716-908-8227

References
ML26273A469 Palisades Nuclear Plant - Emergency License Amendment Request: One-Time-
Use Amendment to Allow Alternative Fuel
ML26275A214 Palisades Nuclear Plant - Response to Request for Additional Information
Regarding Emergency License Amendment



Sent with Proton Mail secure email.
